name: Labubu secret odds by series format
description: Commonly reported secret/chase figure rates for The Monsters blind-box series, by format. The authoritative number for any series is the one printed on that series' own box and product listing; these are collector-reported rates for orientation.
limitations: Collector-reported rates, not an official Pop Mart publication; the box-printed odds outrank every row here.
Rates vary by series and year; we could not verify every series.
Sealed whole-case allocation can differ from independent single-box draws; probability math on these rates models loose boxes.

derived.note: Boxes needed for a 50% chance of at least one secret, independent-draw model: ceil(ln(0.5)/ln(1-1/N)).
